assignment: When people ask for advice, they sometimes talk to more than one person. Explain why seeking multiple opinions can help someone make a better choice. Use specific details and examples in your response.
essay_1:
When you have a hard decision, asking more than one person for advice can help you make a better choice. Everybody sees things through their own life, so one opinion is not always enough.

For example, say a girl is trying to pick between the soccer team and the school play. Her coach might push soccer because he knows she is really talented and would love to have her. Her drama teacher might say the play will build her confidence. Her older brother, who did both, might tell her that the practices are at the same time on Tuesdays and Thursdays. Each person gives her part of the picture, and together they show her what matters to her.

Getting more opinions also helps you catch mistakes. One friend might say a used car is a good deal. A second friend who knows engines could look under the hood and spot a leak the first one missed.

Last, hearing different views makes you think for yourself. You don't just obey one voice. You have to weigh the reasons and pick what fits your life. That is why I think you should talk to a few people before you decide something big.
essay_2:
I think when you have a hard choice to make you should ask more then one person for advice. Everybody sees things different because of there own life, so one person's opinion is only part of it.

Like say a girl is trying to pick between soccer and the school play. Her coach would probably tell her to do soccer because he knows she is good at it. Her drama teacher would say the play will make her more confident. But her older brother did both and he might tell her the practices are at the same time alot and she will be super tired. Everybody tells her something different, and when she puts it all together she can see what actually matters to her.

Asking more people also helps you catch mistakes. If your friend says a used car is a really good deal, another friend who knows about engines might see a leak the first one didnt even notice.

Last, hearing different opinions makes you think for yourself. You cant just do what one person says. You have to look at the reasons and figure out what works for you and your life. Thats how you make a smart choice and not regret it later.
